item.tib: sa bdag dbang chen yar gzhung bder gshegs dkyil 'khor gyi dbu phyogs
item.coloph: de ltar sa bdag dbang chen yar gzhung 'di/ me sbral bzang por bde chen gling pa'o/ 'gal gyur bzod la dge tshogs 'gro la bsngo/ bkra shis dpal gyi 'jig rten rab mdzes te/ bon 'di nyi zer bzhin du dar rgyas shog/
